submission.justification:
Sensor-T3 at 150 μm thickness is recommended for the innermost pixel layer based on achieving the best single-hit spatial resolution of 9.104 μm among viable candidates.

Key findings:
- Sensor-T1 was eliminated due to insufficient radiation hardness (82% efficiency vs. 97% minimum required after 2×10¹⁶ neq/cm² irradiation)
- Both Sensor-T2 and Sensor-T3 meet radiation requirements (99.2% and 98.5% efficiency respectively)
- Sensor-T3 achieves superior spatial resolution (9.104 μm) compared to Sensor-T2 (13.846 μm) at optimal thickness
- This represents a 34.2% resolution improvement over Sensor-T2
- The optimal thickness of 150 μm for Sensor-T3 balances charge collection efficiency and multiple scattering effects
- Thinner sensors (50-100 μm) show degraded resolution due to reduced charge collection
- Thicker sensors (200-300 μm) show degraded resolution due to increased charge diffusion and multiple scattering

Sensor-T3 at 150 μm thickness best fulfills the primary goal of achieving the best possible spatial resolution while meeting all radiation hardness and operational constraints for the high-luminosity LHC innermost tracker layer.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible single-hit spatial resolution in the innermost layer
requirements.evidence: Sensor-T3 at 150 μm achieves 9.104 μm resolution, the best among all viable options. This is 34.2% better than Sensor-T2's best resolution of 13.846 μm.

requirements.requirement: The sensor must be one of the three technologies listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Sensor-T3 is one of the three candidate technologies provided in the specifications.

requirements.requirement: The sensor must be suitable for the radiation environment of the innermost layer
requirements.evidence: Sensor-T3 achieves 98.5% efficiency after irradiation at 2×10¹⁶ neq/cm², exceeding the 97% minimum requirement. Sensor-T1 was rejected for failing this criterion with only 82% efficiency.
Recommended thickness of 150 μm is within the specified range of 50-300 μm.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended technology and thickness
requirements.evidence: Submitting single recommendation: Sensor-T3 at 150 μm thickness.
